summary: Windows-oriented Node/Express and React Gantt application with JSON-file persistence, optional LDAP, admin flows, Windows service host and WiX packaging.
active_objective: Continue post-audit remediation after validating MSI desktop shortcut creation with a real install.
assumptions: Audit was performed in a local Windows test workspace.
The application code was not changed during the audit.
Local or LDAP users without an assigned department keep legacy all-department scope until a stricter role/reparto model is defined.
decisions: Classify the project as Rischioso until server-side authorization and data-integrity risks are addressed.
Keep audit output as root-level markdown and JSON artifacts for follow-up planning.
Department project read, export, save, import and upload now require a valid user/admin session; password-protected departments require per-session password verification before data access.
Keep WiX setup dialog and banner bitmaps text-free in areas where standard WiX dialogs draw their own title, description and body controls.
Use #admin as the client deep link for desktop shortcuts that should open the Admin login tab.
Bump package version to 1.0.1 so rebuilt MSI/setup artifacts are applied as a new installer release.
Suppress WiX ICE38 for the per-machine DesktopFolder URL shortcut components; install validation verifies the files are created on the public desktop.
next_tasks: Decide whether username-only standard login is allowed in production.
Add range validation for system configuration values.
Plan persistence hardening or migration away from fragile JSON writes.
risks: Initial username-only login can grant edit-capable sessions when LDAP and local users are absent.
Users with no department assignment retain all-department scope until role-based department authorization is specified.
JSON file persistence is not safe against multiprocess writes or crash windows.
last_completed_work: Ran elevated MSI install validation for 1.0.1; fixed desktop shortcut target from CommonDesktopFolder to DesktopFolder, verified OnlyGANTT.url and OnlyGANTT Admin.url are created under C:\Users\Public\Desktop, cleaned up installed state, and reran npm run pack/test successfully.
open_questions: Is username-only standard login acceptable outside an explicit demo mode?
What role/reparto authorization model is required for local and LDAP users?
Should generated tool caches remain inside the repository workspace?
handoff_notes: AUD-001 backend authorization is implemented and covered by regression tests. MSI banner/dialog assets are adjusted, installer URL shortcuts use WiX InternetShortcut targeting DesktopFolder, package version is 1.0.1, real MSI install validation confirmed public desktop shortcuts are created, and package/test gates pass. Continue with username-only login hardening, first department password setup protection, config range validation and persistence hardening before treating the system as production-ready.
